- **Date:** 2026-10-11
- **Amount lost:** USD 6.3 million (per the Bridgeport incident post-mortem)
- **Root cause:** Price-oracle manipulation in the withdrawal path. The attacker abused
  manipulated pricing to drain funds from the Bridgeport Gnosis vault.
- **Response / remediation:** Deposits were paused within 40 minutes of the incident.
  A fix (v1.4.2) was deployed and subsequently audited.

## Notes on sourcing

- Date and the USD 6.3M figure come from the project's own post-mortem

  not independently verified on-chain.

  social-media source, contradicted by the project's post-mortem, and not corroborated
  by any other source found. Recorded here only for awareness; the USD 6.3M figure is
  the one used above.

## Open items

- Loss figure is unaudited: neither the USD 6.3M nor the USD 40M+ claim has been
  reconciled against on-chain balances of the vault. If a hard number is needed for
  reserving or disclosure, confirm via on-chain accounting.
- No independent third-party post-mortem or audit report of the incident itself was
